name: ziviSynthi AKS
author: Victor Valentim
tagline: A pin-matrix synthesizer for the M-VAVE SMK-37 Pro
description: An independent firmware inspired by the EMS Synthi AKS, with a 16 × 16 patch matrix, three oscillators, a KS-style sequencer, a step sequencer and a bidirectional Web MIDI editor.
credits: Victor Valentim. Built on fm1-base by Charles Vestal and felucca-bsp by Hügelton Instruments and contributors. Inspired by the EMS Synthi AKS.
